rules.basis: Morningstar prints the array's open-circuit limit under these names across the TriStar, ProStar and SunSaver sheets, sometimes as '150 Volts dc'.
The battery current rating is the controller's output to the battery; the solar or load current ratings are other things.
The sheets state the nominal system voltages the controller auto-detects, as '12/24/48V DC'.

names: Recommended Maximum PV Array Input Power
rules.basis: The TriStar MPPT sheets state a recommended maximum array power per system voltage; the bank voltage is in the figure's name where the sheet prints it.
A controller's self-consumption is what it draws from the battery with nothing to do.
